seo_description: Solo audio designer on a 4-player racing game. Procedural MetaSounds, mix management, and full audio pipeline in 12 weeks.
hero.title: Not Today, Darling!
hero.subtitle: Solo Audio Designer / 4-player side-scrolling racer / 12 weeks
about.text: Chaotic 4-player racer where grannies race, smash, and scream. I designed and implemented all audio: procedural go-kart engine via MetaSounds, surface-reactive driving sounds, priority-based mix for 4 simultaneous players, and recorded character voices with the team.
